title: Reconstruction differences rival individual differences in the fly compass connectome and break trained circuit models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29205v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural network models are increasingly constructed from synapse-resolution connectomes, and the same circuit is now available in reconstructions from other animals and pipelines. We do not know whether such models are dependent on the reconstruction they are built from, and whether connectome differences are biological or measurement errors. We studied the Drosophila head-direction circuit in nine versions: four flies (male CNS, hemibrain, Fly Wire, BANC) and five variants of the same fly varying only by thresholds, proofreading or synapse detection. Using wiring-based correspondences validated by anatomical labels, we place all differences on one scale. A change of synapse detection within one fly changed the circuit more than halfway to the smallest inter-fly difference on four distances; proofreading differences were smaller but depended on the metric, and left and right halves of one fly differed no more than a random half. translated_title: 果蝇罗盘连接组中的重建差异可与个体差异相媲美，并破坏已训练的回路模型
translated_abstract: 神经网络模型越来越多地基于突触分辨率的连接组构建，而同一个回路如今可以在来自不同动物和不同处理流程的重建结果中获得。我们尚不清楚此类模型是否依赖于构建它们所用的重建版本，也不清楚连接组之间的差异究竟是生物学上的还是测量误差。我们研究了果蝇头朝向回路的九个版本：四只果蝇（雄性CNS、半脑hemibrain、Fly Wire、BANC），以及同一只果蝇仅在阈值、校对或突触检测方式上有所不同的五个变体。通过使用经解剖学标记验证的基于线路连接的对应关系，我们将所有差异置于同一尺度上进行比较。结果显示：在同一只果蝇内改变突触检测方法，在四种距离度量上造成的回路变化超过了到达最小果蝇间差异的一半；校对造成的差异较小但依赖于所用的度量指标；而同一只果蝇左右两半之间的差异并不大于随机划分的一半。网络
tldr: 该研究发现果蝇头朝向（罗盘）连接组中由重建流程差异（如突触检测方法）造成的回路变化可与不同果蝇个体之间的生物学差异相媲美，说明基于连接组训练的回路模型依赖于其构建所用的特定重建版本。
en_tdlr: In the fly compass connectome, reconstruction pipeline differences—such as synapse detection changes—rival biological differences between individual flies and break circuit models trained on them, revealing that connectome-based models depend on the specific reconstruction they are built from.
